# HEAD POST

> > HEAD POST delivers international news coverage focusing on geopolitical developments, diplomatic relations, and regional conflicts across Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.

HEAD POST provides analysis and reporting on global affairs with particular emphasis on EU diplomacy, US foreign policy, and conflicts in Ukraine, the Balkans, and the Middle East. The site also features lifestyle content including travel guides to Sofia and the Rila Mountains, along with occasional entertainment and technology pieces.

## Key Topics

- European Union diplomacy
- United States foreign policy
- Ukraine conflict
- Serbia-Kosovo relations
- Middle East politics
- Counter-terrorism
- Balkans politics
- Egypt
- Sofia travel destinations
- Rila Monastery
- EU-Russia relations
- Military aid and defense
- Regional conflicts
- International sanctions
- Diplomatic tensions
